name: ps05-enterprise-intelligence
description: PS-05 Enterprise Intelligence Platform — Unified Analytics & AI Assistant

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
